messages:
Ana: Morning — quick kickoff for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Need privacy/legal signoff + consistent AMI/VM image tagging. Targeting listing slot by next Friday. Who can pick up privacy review?

Mike: I'll take privacy review. Need DPA excerpt and data flow diagram for logs/metrics. Can ops attach the flow and example event JSON?

Laura: Ops can share. For AMI naming I'd propose: redwood-inference-<env>-<semver>-<cloud>-<shortsha>. Also we must include tags for billing and KMS key arn. Example:

```
Name: redwood-inference-prod-1.2.0-aws-6f2b
Tags:
  org: redwood
  product: inference
  release: v1.2.0
  seclvl: p0
```

Suki: DevEx — we'll need bake scripts and user-data template in the listing assets. I'll add a minimal cloud-init snippet and link it in the docs.

Ravi: Packaging note — trial SKU needs to be visible in the store metadata and toggled by feature flag. Also confirm allowed regions for trial images (avoid regions without GPU SKUs).

Mike: Legal asks: make sure telemetry opt-out is documented in the listing and that the EULA matches publisher TOS. I'll post redlines by EOD.

Ana: Action items: @Mike legal signoff + redlines, @Laura AMI naming + sample images in staging, @Suki upload cloud-init and bake scripts into the assets bundle, @Ravi confirm trial SKU labels and region list. Marketplace-bot created checklist: /playbooks/marketplace/checklists/1708453210-marketplace-onboard.md

Laura: I'll upload AMI examples to the staging account and ping here when ready.

Suki: Uploading cloud-init now — will link once done. :thumbsup:

Mike: Posted redlines here: https://drive.redwood/legal/marketplace-redlines-1708453210.pdf

Ana: Great — follow-ups next standup. Thanks everyone :rocket:
